name: Rachel
overview: Scripture introduces Rachel as the beloved daughter of Laban, whom Jacob meets at a well where she is tending her father's sheep. Upon seeing her, Jacob immediately shows deep affection, rolling the stone from the well and weeping as he greets her. Rachel quickly informs her father of Jacob's identity, setting the stage for Jacob's service to Laban to obtain her as his wife. These verses highlight Rachel's role in the unfolding of God's covenant promises through Jacob, emphasizing her significance within the patriarchal narrative.
